description: A Flutter widget implementing a bottom sheet for location search with predefined suggestions, search functionality, and callback for selection.

classes.name: LocationSearchSheet
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that provides a UI for searching and selecting location destinations, with a list of suggestions and search input.

classes.name: _LocationSearchSheetState
classes.description: The state class managing the UI and behavior of LocationSearchSheet, including search filtering and user interactions.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, setting up the filtered suggestions list.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the TextEditingController when the widget is disposed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the location search sheet.

methods.name: _onSearchChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to the search input, filtering suggestions accordingly.
